title: Uniform Whitney remainder estimate for a Lipschitz function on a large closed subset (steps 3, 4 and 7 of Simon's proof of Ch. 2, 1.5)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and L ≥ 0, and let f : ℝ^n → ℝ (ℝ^n = Euclid n) be L-Lipschitz. Let C ⊆ ℝ^n be closed. Assume f is differentiable at every point of C, and that x ↦ Df(x) := fderiv ℝ f x is continuous on C. Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is a closed set A ⊆ C with L^n(C ∖ A) < ε (L^n = volume) with the following property. For every compact Q ⊆ A and every real ε' > 0 there is δ > 0 such that |f(y) − f(x) − Df(x)(y − x)| ≤ ε'|y − x| for all x ∈ Q and y ∈ A with |x − y| < δ. This is Simon's hypothesis 1.6(∗) for h = f and D = Df on A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (C : Set (Euclid n)), LipschitzWith L f → IsClosed C → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) C → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Euclid n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < δ → ‖f y - f x - fderiv ℝ f x (y - x)‖ ≤ ε' * ‖y - x‖
